missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Настроение' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Хорошее' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'сегодня' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Настроение' is the neuter accusative object of 'подняла', identical to the nominative. 'Мне' is the dative experiencer.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Настроения' is the genitive after 'нет', marking the lack of mood. 'Работать' is the infinitive of purpose.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Настроением' is the instrumental, the quality that pleases. 'Своим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О настроении' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Его' shows whose mood.
Strategic focus: Prepositional state. 'В настроении' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to express being in a mood. 'Хорошем' agrees in the neuter prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'на'. 'Настроение' is the neuter accusative after 'на', the thing affected. 'Погода' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Настроения' is the genitive after 'от', the thing depended on. 'Своего' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Настроения' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural after 'под'. 'Настроения' is the neuter accusative plural after 'под', the moods the book suits. 'Разные' agrees with it.
